description: Current observed weather conditions for an agricultural region — temperature, humidity, wind, and sky conditions from the nearest NOAA National Weather Service station. Use for right-now conditions; use get_forecast instead for the outlook ahead, and get_weather_history for what the past days actually delivered. Live proxy to NOAA — nothing is stored, so values are as of the station's latest observation; no API key. An unknown location key or a NOAA outage returns a source-unavailable error.

location.description: Location key (IL-central, IA-central, NE-central, IN-central, KS-central). Default: IL-central

name: get_weather
